definition: Tourette’s disorder is a neuropsychological condition linked to dopamine-related changes in frontal-subcortical brain circuits. It involves several movement tics and at least one vocal tic that happen very frequently for longer than a year, start before age 18, cause substantial distress or problems in important areas of life, and are not better explained by a substance or another medical condition.
